$comment: OpenClaw/MCP tool manifest for the Nara-on-NemoClaw agent bundle (β groundwork, 2026-06-09, Limb D). STATIC MIRROR of orchestrator/tool_plane.py's GET /tools — keep the two in lockstep (tests/test_tool_plane.py::test_manifest_matches_the_agent_bundle_tool_name guards the tool name). The agent runs INSIDE nara-sandbox and reaches this HOST endpoint through the NemoClaw egress proxy; see docs/nemoclaw_smoke_runbook.md for the hostname-vs-IP + egress allow-rule nuance.

transport.$comment: base_url is a PLACEHOLDER. Fill <HOST_HOSTNAME> with the host's resolvable hostname (NOT a raw IP — the egress SSRF guard 403s bare-IP literals; Limb D proved hostname:8000=200, IP=403) and <PORT> with the tool plane's --port (default 8077).
